edition.notes: Catalog-level record created 2026-07-25. Documents volume printing the Vatican trial dossier (Processo di Galileo) with diplomatic notes: the qualifiers' propositions and censure (pp. 320-321), the minutes of 25-26 February 1616 (pp. 321-322), the Holy Office session of 3 March 1616 (p. 278), the Index decree of 5 March 1616 (pp. 322-323), Bellarmine's certificate of 26 May 1616 (autograph, p. 348; Galileo's copy, p. 342), and the 1633 records (pp. 342-348, 404-405). Read in the public Internet Archive scan agh6462.0019.001.umich.edu, whose title page imprint reads Firenze 1907. No exact artifact is registered here.
edition.title: Le Opere di Galileo Galilei, Edizione Nazionale, volume XIX (documents, including the trial dossier)

alternate_titles: Edizione Nazionale delle Opere di Galileo
work.author: Galileo Galilei; edited by Antonio Favaro
work.description: The twenty-volume national edition of Galileo's works and correspondence (Florence: Barbera, 1890-1909), edited by Antonio Favaro, printing the Vatican trial dossier and the correspondence with diplomatic notes. The controlling witness for the Bellarmine-Galileo documents used in this repository: the 1611 letters, the 12 April 1615 letter to Foscarini, the February-March 1616 Holy Office and Index documents, and the 26 May 1616 certificate in its two dossier witnesses.
work.title: Le Opere di Galileo Galilei, Edizione Nazionale
